sources.ref: arkona-site.html (saved copy of the Arkona homepage)

name.note: From the site name and the footer, which reads Arkona ApS.

colors.primary.note: The deep green of the logo, the navigation, the links and the buttons.

colors.foreground.note: The site's body text, a green-tinted near-black.

colors.secondary.note: The sand colour of the site's feature band and button hover.

typography.body.note: The site's text face, an open Google font.

typography.heading.note: The site's heading serif, also used in the wordmark.

typography.headingWeight.note: Headings on the site are set semibold, not bold.

logo.note: The A mark and ARKONA wordmark from the site header, in one green.

voice.register.value: plain, concrete, craft-minded; short declarative sentences naming materials and numbers

voice.sample.value: Larch from the Baltic coast grows slowly, so the wood is dense and resinous. We leave it untreated or oil it once.

notes.name: We took the name from the site and the footer; documents say Arkona and leave the ApS to legal papers.
notes.logo: The logo is the green A mark and wordmark from the top of your site, used as it is.
notes.tone: Your site speaks plainly about wood, steel and numbers, so documents do the same: short sentences, concrete facts, no sales talk.
